chatgpt_features_mentioned_in_docs.notes: Canvas is an in-product interface for writing and coding work that supports edit revisions, in-line feedback, project-level context, and can be opened automatically for larger outputs or via prompt commands.
Deep Research lets users define a research goal, choose sources (web, uploaded files, connected apps), get a proposed plan, monitor progress, and receive a cited structured report.
Memory stores high-level preferences/context across chats (when enabled), supports Saved Memories and chat-history reference settings, and can be paused/cleared via settings with user control.

Projects provide grouped workspaces for chats, files, and instructions so context stays together; support project-specific memory and can include app usage, with sharing available in many plans/workspaces.

Custom GPTs are configurable ChatGPT variants with instructions, knowledge, tool capabilities, and sharing/visibility controls; they are created/edited via paid plans and function as no-code assistants inside ChatGPT.

Advanced Data Analysis (Code Interpreter) supports uploading/inspecting files, tables/charts, and running Python-based computations for data cleaning, summaries, and visualizations; external web/API access is not performed by this environment.

Official help now frames connectors as apps: external services that provide in-chat actions or contextual retrieval/search/deep-research support; docs include app capabilities and security/data-sharing controls.

Voice mode enables spoken conversations with spoken responses on web/mobile, supports controls for mic/voice settings and captions, but does not support some tools (e.g., file uploads and Code Interpreter) during voice sessions.
